name: parse jsonl and sort records by an iso timestamp per group key
definition: Read JSON-lines log events and sort the records belonging to the same question id chronologically by their microsecond-timestamp field.
failure_mode: Out-of-order sorting misassigns rounds and wrong per-run content.

name: parse SMILES into a molecular object and reject invalid input
definition: Convert SMILES strings to a chemistry toolkit object, returning None for invalid/empty input rather than raising.
failure_mode: Invalid SMILES raise an exception or valid returns None.
